figures.name: figure_P1_runtime_breakdown
figures.caption: Matched explicit timers, without cProfile. Components exclude initialization, HDF output and diagnostic recording. The recorded residual Python/timer overhead is reported in JSON, so bars are not claimed to exhaust total runtime.

figures.name: figure_P2_effective_dt
figures.caption: All accepted steps of the selected segments. Macro-boundary remainders are included and explicitly counted; the smallest dt is not automatically a stiffness measurement. Not a full gold timestep histogram.

figures.name: figure_P3_limiter_particles
figures.caption: Particle-limit events only; macro-boundary remainders excluded from the denominator. Category percentages overlap and must not be added. Global IDs, not compact active-array indices; every-step details remain in TIMESTEP_LIMITER_ANALYSIS.

figures.name: figure_P4_wall_backend
figures.caption: Build/compile excluded after warmup; Warp host adapter includes actual transfers. Query speed alone does not imply projection or trajectory equivalence. Geometry decision errors and adoption gates are reported separately.

figures.name: figure_P5_speedup_error
figures.caption: Zero errors stay exactly zero on a symmetric-log axis. Circles pass the strict P1 trajectory/contact gate, crosses fail it. Each point is one segment; failed/incomplete trajectories are excluded from speedup claims and retained in failure records.

figures.name: figure_P6_cumulative_assignments
figures.caption: Exact saved first-crossing event times; 256 initial particles per case. A plateau while particles remain unassigned does not authorize early termination or establish their eventual branch.
